lcc_original: 上帝說：『地要發生青草、和結種子的菜蔬、跟結果子的樹在地上，各從其類，果子裏有種子：』就這樣成了。
notes: LCC explicitly renders '在地上' (on the earth) for UNV's implicit {<WAH05921>}{<WH0776>}; braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC '裏' (inside) explicitly renders UNV's implicit {<WAH09002>} (Heb. בוֹ 'in it'); braces dropped per Rule 3
LCC '有' (to have/exist) in '果子裏有種子' has no Hebrew equivalent; left unannotated per Rule 5
LCC uses '樹' vs UNV '樹木'; same SNs (H6529+H6086) transferred to the shorter form
